name: Spotify
description: Your Spotify library as music in Plex and Plexamp: liked songs, your playlists and saved albums, with Spotify's titles, albums and covers, and each playlist in Spotify's order. Connect by picking this device in the Spotify app. The sound comes from YouTube, through the YouTube addon (needed, signed in): each song plays as its recording there, so now and then a version differs.

config.label: New songs to look for on YouTube each sync (an hour apart)
